summary: Lambda's Research Grant offers qualifying researchers up to $5,000 in credits for Lambda on-demand GPU Instances. The research hub (lambda.ai/research) hosts the apply-for-a-grant CTA and describes the program as research and mentorship; the $5,000 figure is stated on Lambda's CVPR 2026 page and ICLR 2026 blog, which point applicants back to lambda.ai/research. The ICLR post addresses independent researchers who need compute; the official pages reviewed do not require venture backing or state a card requirement.
claim_steps: Review the grant CTA on lambda.ai/research.
Apply for the Lambda Research Grant (competitive; qualifying researchers).
If awarded, use credits on Lambda on-demand GPU Instances.
